result:
The DE operating account reconciliation is closed out and ties. Here's what I found and did.

**The difference was €14,908.50, made up of four items — two book errors, two reconciling items.**

Opening balances agreed (€415,000.32 book and bank), so everything arose in March.

**Fixed in the books (with support):**
1. **Duplicate payment, €6,480** — JE-00272 and JE-00273 were identical entries for the same Rheinbyte invoice RB-2026-0318, posted ~15 hours apart by the same AP clerk against the same support doc. The invoice is for one amount and the bank shows only one SEPA debit. Reversed the later one via **JE-00309** (support: DOC-0165, DOC-0202). This also un-overstates AP.
2. **Unrecorded bank fee, €38.50** — the 3/31 monthly service charge was never booked. Posted **JE-00310**, Dr 6900 / Cr 1000 (support: DOC-0202).

**Left alone — correctly booked timing difference:**
3. **Deposit in transit, €18,200** — the Kessler AG receipt on RE-7090. The remittance advice explicitly says the transfer was initiated after bank cut-off on 3/31, so it's a genuine timing difference, not an error. No entry made.

**Flagged rather than forced:**
4. **Unidentified debit, €3,150** — BT-DE-0045, "SEPA OUT REF TX-44817." No ledger entry and no supporting document anywhere in the store references either the reference number or the amount; payee and purpose are undeterminable. I deliberately did **not** plug it to Suspense, per policy s.11. Logged as **EXC-001**.

Worth your attention: this is the only March cash outflow with no authorizing document at all, so I'd treat it as a possible unauthorized payment rather than a simple posting omission — Treasury should pull the payee detail from the bank and consider a SEPA recall while the window is still open.

**Final rec:** €363,817.86 book − €18,200 deposit in transit − €3,150 unbooked debit = **€342,467.86 = bank**. All 19 bank lines matched except the flagged one.

One judgment call to confirm: I set the DE "Bank reconciliations" checklist item to *in_progress*, not *complete*, because EXC-001 is still open and the DE payroll account (GL 1010) rec was outside this task's scope. Let me know if you'd rather I close the item and track the exception separately, or if you want me to pick up the 1010 reconciliation next.
